about_the_game:
“And yet—what does true happiness really mean?”

This is the official Setting & Art Book for Twilight Railway, the additional content for Saihate Station.
It features the world setting, development materials, and a rich collection of artwork from the DLC.

Compared to the main game, this volume includes a greatly expanded art gallery, along with never-before-told stories, background details, and behind-the-scenes production notes.

Specifications

B5 / Full color / 82 pages / Japanese only

Contents

  • Memories of the Characters – Character design materials

  • Revisiting the Journey of Twilight Railway – Maps, event illustrations, and hidden lore

  • The Making of This World – Idea sketches and concept notes

  • Unused Events & Additional Illustrations

Notes

Please note that this is not the setting & art book for the Saihate Station main story.
All content in this volume is exclusive to the DLC Twilight Railway.

How to View

  • Download Saihate Station on Steam.

  • In your Steam Library, right-click Saihate Station and select Properties.

  • Go to the DLC tab and make sure “Saihate Station [Twilight Railway] Official Setting & Art Book” is marked as downloaded.

  • In the same window, open the Installed Files tab and click Browse.

  • Open the file 251029_tasogare_art.work.pdf using any PDF viewer of your choice.
